title: Rook Behind Rook
setup: Black has two rooks in play, and one of them shares the sixth rank with its king on c6.
hint: Which square on the sixth rank does one of your pieces already defend? Check from there.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rb6+}} is a skewer along the sixth rank: the king in front, the rook on **f6** behind. The bishop on **f2** guards b6, so the check cannot be taken, and every flight square but c7 is covered. {{Kc7}}, and {{Rxf6}} wins the rook.
